title: Calendaring and scheduling website
description: Let people register, create events, invite others by email, and view registered invitees' free/busy information. Explain the overlap SQL and how the database scales beyond one machine.
focus: relational modeling, internal/external attendees, recurring events, time zones, free/busy correctness, and partitioning.

title: Most-shared articles across regions
description: Aggregate the N most-shared articles globally in near-real time over the last five minutes, one hour, and one day, with 1M–10M distinct shared articles per day.
focus: asynchronous multi-region collection, article identity, three rolling windows, expiration without new events, safe Top-N merging, and snapshot serving.

title: Metric collection and querying
description: Collect metrics from a large fleet and return either one node's metric history or a metric aggregated across all nodes. Support metric discovery, one-year retention, and fast recent queries.
focus: durable collection, time-series storage, fleet pre-aggregation, availability, freshness, and multi-datacenter operation.

title: Evolve a single-machine key-value store
description: Build around an existing high-performance store to provide scalable, durable, highly available put/get/delete operations without rewriting the local storage engine.
focus: sharding, metadata and routing, replicated writes, safe failover, online data movement, and strong-consistency follow-ups.

title: Top requests over the last 24 hours
description: Find the N most frequent search strings, requested keys, or other request identities across hundreds of machines over the trailing 24 hours, with efficient computation and network use.
focus: source collection, lossless local combining, key-based partitioning, rolling expiration, exact Top-N merging, and replay-safe recovery.
